policy: HIGH severity always blocks. MEDIUM blocks unless triaged here with a matching file, rule and maximum count. Any B608 in src/api/ always blocks because that layer receives user input.

findings.justification: Table name comes from the ENTITIES dictionary in source control and the column list from the same dictionary. The file path is bound as a parameter. No request or file content reaches the SQL text.
Predicates are composed from src/quality/rules.py, a reviewed rule catalogue in source control. Temp table and schema names are constants. Watermarks and batch ids are bound parameters.
Only the MERCHANT_KEY and CUSTOMER_KEY surrogate-key expressions (module constants) are interpolated. Batch ids and watermarks are bound parameters.
